subject: Ownership time-map + exception commitments for Novatech MAP
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@novatech.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: mutual action plan (90-day) + owners — Novatech

Hi Clara / team,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday — great alignment on priorities. I attached a first-pass MAP and an ownership time-map that breaks the implementation into lanes (Integration, Data & Security, Training, Go-live) with milestone dates and primary owners.

High-level asks from us:
- Confirm internal Novatech owners on the right column by EOD Fri (6/20).
- Confirm the target go-live window (we proposed 9/1–9/7) so we can lock capacity.
- Flag any compliance or procurement gating items that would change sequencing.

Key constraints we surfaced: data egress approvals (Legal), network firewall schedule (Ops), and a short pilot for the embeddings pipeline. We added contingency lanes for each.

Attached: Novatech_MAP_v1.xlsx (map + milestone owners) and network-checklist.pdf (network prerequisites).

Next step: If Novatech confirms owners + go-live window, we’ll convert this to the operational RACI and schedule the 30/60/90 check-ins.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Novatech_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 62KB)
- network-checklist.pdf (pdf, 28KB)

From: Clara Diaz <clara.diaz@novatech.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 13:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft: mutual action plan (90-day) + owners — Novatech

Tessa,

Appreciate the clear breakdown — this is helpful. A few quick notes after reviewing with our platform leads:

- Confirmed owners: I’ll be the executive sponsor, but the day-to-day owners will be:
  * Integration: Marco Alvarez (marco.alvarez@novatech.com)
  * Network/Firewall: Priya Shah (priya.shah@novatech.com) — she’s OOO 6/19–6/22, will confirm on 6/23.
  * Data Governance: Li Chen (li.chen@novatech.com)
  * Training/Adoption: Sameera Patel (sameera.patel@novatech.com)
- Go-live window: 9/1–9/7 works for now, pending procurement approval (we expect a PO by 8/1).
- Security: We need the SOC 2 artifacts and token-handling diagram before 7/2 for our internal audit.

I’ll mark the spreadsheet with the owners and return by Monday morning (6/23). Can we move the 30-day checkpoint one week earlier (target week of 7/7) to align with our Q3 readiness sprint?

Thanks,
Clara
VP, Platform Operations
Novatech Solutions

Clara —
Thanks for the rapid review and the owner list. A few operational clarifications from our side:

- SOC 2 artifacts: I’ll upload the SOC 2 summary and the token-handling diagram to the shared Doc today (linked in thread). Expect to see them by 16:00 PT.
- Network window: our infra team can schedule a firewall test window during 7/21–7/25; if Novatech prefers earlier we can try to reallocate, but there is a constraint with other go-lives that week.
- Pilot: We propose a two-week pilot (8/11–8/25) limited to a single data partition; we’ll run regression prompts and quality gates during that window.

I updated the MAP spreadsheet with explicit acceptance criteria for the Integration and Pilot milestones so we have a binary go/no-go at each checkpoint.

Monica
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Clara — quick note from the engineering side on sequencing and resource commits:

- Integration tasks marked "Dev (Redwood)" are scoped for a 3-week effort if we get networking signed off by 7/10. If firewall validation slips past 7/25 we may need to compress the pilot or add a second engineer for ramp.
- Marcus and I will reserve a slot on our capacity plan for the week of 8/11 to run the pilot and readiness checks. We can confirm specific engineer names next week.

Actionable items for this thread:
1) Novatech to confirm Priya Shah’s network approval date (target 6/23).
2) Novatech to provide PO or procurement timeline (target 8/1).
3) Redwood to provide SOC 2 summary + token diagram (Monica to upload today).

I’ll add a short contingency line to the spreadsheet showing compression options (add headcount vs shorten pilot) so we have clear tradeoffs.

—Jordan

Team —
Quick update after speaking with Priya and Procurement:

- Priya confirmed the firewall approval: validation scheduled for 7/22; she’ll share specifics and the change window by Monday 6/23.
- Procurement: PO is on track for 8/1; finance flagged one contract exception around data retention that Legal is reviewing.
- Owners: I updated the spreadsheet with the names you asked for; see the Google Doc link in your thread.

Given the 7/22 network date, we agreed this plan:
- Keep the pilot as planned (8/11–8/25).
- Move 30-day checkpoint to week of 7/14 (to allow one pre-network readiness check).
- Redwood: please prepare the SOC 2 summary and the token diagram by 7/2 so our audit team can review.
